responsibility: Implements lowering from High GIMPLE to Low GIMPLE. It removes lexical GIMPLE_BIND structure, lowers EH constructs into CFG/region form, canonicalizes multiple returns into shared return sites, rewrites certain built-ins such as setjmp, posix_memalign, and assume_aligned into lower-level GIMPLE patterns, and records local variables into function state, producing the simpler low-level GIMPLE form expected by subsequent middle-end passes.
same_name_distinction: Contains the actual High-to-Low GIMPLE lowering pass implementation, including body lowering, return unification, EH/bind lowering, and special builtin rewrites, whereas the header only exposes a small set of related helper/query declarations.
